snippet.title: The Labyrinth on Burrow Hill -  Trailer 1
snippet.description:
The Labyrinth on Burrow Hill - COMING THIS JUNE!
This is my latest indie game and has been most of my life for the last few months. It's an atmospheric puzzle-filled adventure set in the mysterious halls of a colossal labyrinth, do you have what it takes to find your way to the centre? I really hope you'll support me and check it out when the game drops!! thanks everyone :-)
check out my itch.io for updates: https://planetjonbo.itch.io/
and follow me on ig: @planetjonbo 

game dev, indie game, small game developer,
